Let's work together

I work with researchers, conservation organizations, and teams collecting data and building tools. Get in touch if you have a project that needs resource, or want to collaborate.

Things I can help with

  • Underwater surveys and imaging: survey planning, photogrammetry, 3D reconstruction, and reef mapping.
  • Research software and data: image-processing workflows, automation, interactive maps, and tools for exploring scientific data.
  • Product and communication: product development, user research, interface design, data visualization, and making research understandable to the people who need it.

Tell me what you're working on, who it's for, and where you need help. If there's a location, dataset, or deadline involved, include that too.

Connecting fieldwork, research, and design

My work brings together experience in product design, underwater research, and scientific publishing. I'm interested in ecological change, deep time, and how people participate in thriving ecosystems across generations.
